configuration_policy.selection: Development-only lexicographic ordering by major-top precision, pattern precision, band agreement, then recall; one validation audit of the winner.

decision_outcomes.go: All label-quality, integrity, point-in-time, performance, coverage, negative-control, and review-efficiency gates pass.
decision_outcomes.inconclusive: Label stability fails or required blind labels/samples cannot be frozen.
decision_outcomes.no_go: A hard integrity/point-in-time gate or a frozen performance threshold fails.

holdout_policy: Holdout labels are a separate artifact and may be loaded only after manifest, protocol, code commit, detector configuration, fingerprints, and evaluation command are frozen.

labeling.pattern_positive: Human coil versus non-abstained high-confidence qualified detector structure.
labeling.top_matching: Maximum one-to-one bipartite match within one completed quarter.

sampling_note: Cohorts are frozen sampling strata, pending confirmation by blind human labels; they are not ground truth and cannot satisfy a gate by themselves.
